High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 529 Bnss No. - 1782 of 2025
Applicant :- Smt. Anuradha Alias Priyanka

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Aaditya Vikram Bisen,Vipan Kumar

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed with a prayer to direct the court concerned to expedite the trial of the Complaint Case No. 87 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Alau, District- Mainpuri pending in the Court of learned Civil Judge (J.D.)/ Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Mainpuri expeditiously within stipulated period.

entities.text: Civil Judge (J.D.)/ Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Mainpuri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant before this Court is the complainant in the aforesaid case, which pertains to the year 2021.

It is further submitted that the accused persons have appeared before the Court, however, an application for discharge under Section 245 (2) Cr.P.C. was moved by them and the same is still pending and since then they are not appearing before the Court.

It is also submitted that the Court concerned is not taking any interest Smt. Anuradha Alias Priyanka vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160993608/
1 for disposal of the case.

entities.text: Smt. Anuradha Alias Priyanka vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

6. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to dispose of the aforesaid discharge application in accordance with law within two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it, if there is no legal impediment.
7.

The Court concerned is further directed that if charges are framed against the accused persons all endevours shall be made by the trial Court to decide the aforesaid case in expeditiously in accordance with law.
It is further directed that no unnecessary adjournment will be sought/granted.

8. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 3.6.2025 Fhd  Smt. Anuradha Alias Priyanka vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160993608/
